title: HT Morning Brief Oct 20: Delhi air quality improves after rain, Netanyahu's party falls short of majority in Israel elections | India News
text:
Rain brings relief from pollution in Delhi
Delhi is likely to witness another spell of rain on Friday after overnight showers brought down temperatures across the national capital. The rainfall also brought some relief from pollution, with Delhi's air quality improving to the satisfactory category on Friday morning after several days of poor air quality. Delhi's air quality index (AQI) was recorded at 90 at 9.05 am, a drop of 132 points from Thursday's reading of 222 at 4 pm, when the air quality was in the poor category. While 16 monitoring stations reported moderate air quality, the remaining stations recorded satisfactory levels. Read more here.
